$comment: AI-rendered reference photos of the catalogue's products (D-426): one per product, generated from the product's spec with Google Stitch (Gemini image), blank packaging on white. Placed with `pnpm catalog:product-photos public/media/products/manifest.json --confirm --as <staff>`. A real photograph of the product replaces its render through the admin (source `getpack`); the script never replaces a photo of another source.
